name: Johansson trucker cap (shop display)

purpose.for: Customers at Sakura Shōten looking at Johansson's trucker caps on the cap tree by the east window, before they ask Thuan for one: the boats' crews, the catch sorters and the cargo quay.
purpose.why: Six caps stand on the stand at once; at the worn cap's detail they took Sakura over its phone budget, so the stand shows the same cap built for being looked at from the shop floor, under half the triangles.
purpose.where: On the two cap forms of Sakura's cap tree (src/world/interiors/sakura-cap-stand.js), stacked three to a form; never on a head, where the worn cap (johansson-trucker) goes.

notes: The shop display's level of detail of johansson-trucker, built by the same script (build-johansson-trucker.py --display): the same shape, frame, colours and J; fewer segments, no lining, sweatband rows, strap studs or stitching geometry (the cap sits on a form; the stitching is the worn cap's). Recoloured per colourway on the stand as a head's hatColour and accent do.

checks.detail: Who it is for, why they want it and where it belongs are written down.
johansson-trucker-display is used by nothing else in Studio or World.
Lowest point at y = 0.000 m; all 6 pieces rest on the floor or on each other.
0.48 × 0.32 × 0.66 m (w × h × d). Its top is below the knee of a 1.6 m resident.
1298 of 1500 triangles, 4 of 4 materials, 6 draw calls.
